run_async_client_violation_scan: run the async client violation scan across the litellm codebase to detect per-request async handler instantiation
check_file_for_async_handler: check a single python file for AsyncHttpHandler or httpx.AsyncClient instantiation using AST parsing
scan_directory_for_async_violations: scan a directory tree for python files that instantiate AsyncHttpHandler or AsyncClient directly
test_no_async_handler_usage: test that no async http handler violations exist in the litellm codebase directory
review_allowed_files_whitelist: review the ALLOWED_FILES whitelist to see which files are exempt from the async client instantiation check
